events.text: A hospital hulk, drifting, her wards stripped to the frames. In the surgery a mounting ring still holds a jointed arm, folded at the elbow like a sleeper. A sign above it reads: PLEASE DO NOT LIE ON THE ARM.

choices.text: Trace the arm's drive and copy the plans.

outcomes.text: The drive is intact enough to read. You leave with the plans of a medbay that comes to the patient, and a small pride in your handwriting.
The drive is burnt out. You take what copper the surgery has left and the arm stays folded.

choices.text: Leave her wards to the dark.

outcomes.text: The arm stays folded in the dark. It has waited this long.

events.text: A Lumen clinic skiff, cold and perfect. Over the one cot a green halo hangs in the air at the end of a slim arm and, as you come in, turns slowly to find you.

choices.text: Ask the clinic for its specification.

outcomes.text: The halo dims, then writes. A full specification of the arm unrolls across your console, with a note in a neat hand: 'Please lose fewer people.'
The halo considers you for a long moment and dims. Nothing is written. It has declined, kindly.

choices.text: Leave the clinic as you found it.

outcomes.text: The halo turns to follow you to the door and holds there, patient.
